# Work With Neehal

> Muhammad Neehal Shahid is a frontend developer (React) and WordPress developer based in Karachi, Pakistan, building websites and web apps for agencies, startups, and local businesses.

Work With Neehal covers two service tracks: WordPress for content-driven business sites the client can edit themselves, and React (Vite) for products that need real interactivity — dashboards, custom logic, and interfaces WordPress can't cleanly handle. This site itself is a React 18 + Vite build, not a page builder or template.

## Pages

- [Home](https://workwithneehal.com/): Overview, featured work, the difference between this and a typical freelancer, and the two service tracks.
- [Projects](https://workwithneehal.com/projects): Four live WordPress case studies for real clients — an agency, a solar company, and an electrical contractor.
- [Services](https://workwithneehal.com/services): Full breakdown of both tracks — WordPress (business websites, landing pages, WooCommerce, migrations, performance, maintenance) and React (web apps, marketing sites, frontend modernization, component libraries).
- [About](https://workwithneehal.com/about): How Neehal works, what he values (clarity, ownership, reliability, craft), and the tools he uses.
- [Contact](https://workwithneehal.com/contact): Project inquiry form, plus email/LinkedIn/Upwork.

## Case studies

- [Hamkoders](https://workwithneehal.com/projects/hamkoders): Creative/digital agency site (hamkoders.com).
- [The Brandbyte](https://workwithneehal.com/projects/brandbyte): AI-powered digital agency site (thebrandbyte.com).
- [Flip Solar](https://workwithneehal.com/projects/flipsolar): Solar company site with a load calculator (theflipsolar.com).
- [Elfa Energy](https://workwithneehal.com/projects/elfaenergy): Electrical contracting & MEP services site (elfaenergy.com).
